stages.name: sweep-files
stages.instruction: Audit each file for macOS/Linux portability traps, missing subprocess timeouts, unclosed handles, broken flags, or onboarding friction. Return concise bullet findings with file + line hint.
stages.reduce_instruction: Deduplicate and rank all findings into P0 (breaks macOS/Linux users), P1 (reliability/timeout hazards), and P2 (docs/UX polish) with exact file targets.
